Updated: September 4, 2025 @ 12:20 am
A woman sustained severe injuries after law enforcement responded to a medical call in New York Mills on Aug. 30.
Justin Lemon, 38, of New York Mills was taken into custody and booked for felony domestic assault and 3rd degree assault.
According to a press release from the Otter Tail County Sheriff’s Office, at about 3:32 p.m. the sheriff's office responded to a reported medical at a residence on South Main Avenue in New York Mills and found a female victim lying on the floor with significant facial trauma which appeared to have been caused by an assault.
No other details about what led up to the assault were released.
After securing the scene, sheriff’s office deputies, New York Mills Rescue, and Astera Ambulance provided medical attention to the victim before she was transported to Perham Health, and later airlifted to a hospital in Fargo where her condition is listed as stable.
The sheriff’s office said Lemon was located inside the residence and arrested without incident.
